program.merge_policy: accumulate twenty 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after Wave 1000

policy.validation_strategy: PMID-level dedupe during authoring; full repository validation only after Wave 1000

waves.focus: Standardized Salvia officinalis acute four-dose RCT in 20 healthy older adults; selected memory/attention signals with very small sample and acute extract-specific boundary.
Salvia officinalis leaf extract trial in 80 adults with T2D/hyperlipidemia; glycemic/lipid marker improvements remain disease-, duration-, and extract-specific.
Salvia officinalis add-on trial in 100 dyslipidemic T2D participants; selected glycemic/lipid improvements with BMI/AST/ALT/creatinine nulls.
Four-study/310-participant hot-flush meta-analysis; frequency favored sage while severity was not significant and heterogeneity was high.
Three-study diabetes meta-analysis; FBS/HbA1c/TC/LDL signals with TG/HDL nulls and very small evidence base.
Systematic review of human Salvia cognition studies; heterogeneous preparations and incomplete product characterization limit generalization.
SAGE-718/dalzanemdor Huntington-disease trial is a pharmaceutical code/name collision, not botanical sage evidence; preserve as identity-contamination guardrail.
Single-dose Zembrin pharmaco-fMRI study in 16 participants; amygdala threat-reactivity/coupling changes are surrogate neuroimaging evidence only.
Human-safety/evidence-gap source retained as research-gap context rather than efficacy; do not promote preclinical mechanism into human benefit.
Cognition systematic review/meta-analysis; overall cognitive benefit was not significant, providing a direct counterweight to nootropic claims.
Human cognition synthesis found no significant overall cognitive improvement; useful null counterweight for Centella claims.
Eight-week standardized Ocimum tenuiflorum RCT in 100 stressed adults; stress/sleep biomarker and subjective signals remain product- and population-specific.
Human randomized trial of lion's-mane preparation; formulation and chronic-use boundaries retained, including null outcomes where reported.
Second human lion's-mane RCT; acute/chronic and formulation distinctions retained rather than merged into a generic nootropic claim.
Panax quinquefolius human evidence; species identity must remain distinct from Panax ginseng and red-ginseng findings.
Umbrella review: favorable safety profile but no established insomnia efficacy; subjective sleep outcomes were stronger than objective measures.
Chamomile sleep systematic review; possible sleep signals remain heterogeneous and preparation-specific.
Clinical anxiety evidence showed no significant overall effect; retain as counterweight to broad anxiolytic claims.
Saffron safety systematic review; safety/tolerability evidence retained separately from efficacy and long-term-use assumptions.
Later depression/anxiety synthesis; preserve diagnosis, comparator, extract and heterogeneity boundaries rather than generic mood claims.
Eleven-trial/1,093-participant depression synthesis; small pooled effect, very-low certainty and effect below minimal-important-difference threshold.
Oral Silexan-specific evidence; cannot be generalized to inhaled lavender, teas, essential oils or unspecified lavender products.
IBS systematic review; response signal around RR 1.53 with indication-specific and fiber-formulation boundaries.
27-RCT anthropometric synthesis; weight-related outcomes kept separate from lipid/glycemic/IBS evidence and from weight-loss marketing.
Glycemic systematic review; glucose-related findings remain disease/population and dietary-adjunct specific.
